summary.root_cause_text: The database became read-only ("attempt to write a readonly database"), so POST /orders fails with 500 and ledger sync fails. The underlying cause is unknown and is probably at the file, permission, disk or mount level.
recommended: A human should check the DB file permissions, disk space or mount state (read-only remount) and the host filesystem, and restore write access.
After that, run check_invariants and confirm the ledger sync catches up.
Rollback, restart and config changes are not applicable and would not fix a read-only DB.
